display_long_description:
You have one goal… 

**SMASH ‘EM**

Fight through hordes of angry enemies in order to get revenge on them for taking over your world.  Use your fists, various weapons, and even powers in order to defeat the horde.

As you progress through the levels, receive various upgrades as the enemies get more difficult.

**Intense Melee Combat!**

[media]

**Cause Chaos!**

Cause extreme carnage and chaos through your violence!

[media]

**Use Powers!**

Leverage the use of more than four different powers to defeat your foes!

[media]

**More than 10 weapons!**

Take advantage of more than 10 different unique weapons to cause the most creative violence.

[media]
